{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
library(igraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(viridis)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))

label_condition <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
    grepl("mCh-",   x) ~ "mCh-",
    grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
    TRUE                ~ x
  )
}
```

```{r config}
INCLUDE_CLUSTERS <- c("6", "8", "2", "5", "1", "4")
N_PCA_DIMS       <- 20L
PCA_NAME         <- "pca.SCT"
# Run with 4 as start so the MST topology is resolved correctly,
# then reverse pseudotime so 0 = progenitor (c6/c8) and max = c4.
START_CLUSTER    <- "4"
END_CLUSTERS     <- c("6", "8")
N_BINS_HM        <- 50L
N_TOP_GENES_HM   <- 100L
N_TOP_GENES_LINE <- 3L
```

# Load & subset

```{r load}
mpn_processed_hsc <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)

clus_col <- grep("sNN_pca\\..*_res\\.0\\.9$",
                 colnames(mpn_processed_hsc@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]
cat("Cluster column:", clus_col, "\n")

clus_all <- as.character(mpn_processed_hsc@meta.data[[clus_col]])
names(clus_all) <- colnames(mpn_processed_hsc)

sling_cells <- names(clus_all)[clus_all %in% INCLUDE_CLUSTERS]
clus        <- clus_all[sling_cells]
cat("Clusters:", paste(sort(unique(clus)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Cells:", length(sling_cells), "\n")

pca_emb <- Seurat::Embeddings(mpn_processed_hsc, PCA_NAME)[sling_cells, seq_len(N_PCA_DIMS)] |>
  as.data.frame()

# UMAP — full dataset as background, subset cells for trajectory overlay
umap_red <- grep("^umap", names(mpn_processed_hsc@reductions), value = TRUE)[1]
umap_full <- Seurat::Embeddings(mpn_processed_hsc, umap_red) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  dplyr::rename(umap1 = 1, umap2 = 2) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = clus_all[cell_id])

umap_df <- umap_full |> dplyr::filter(cell_id %in% sling_cells)

centroids <- umap_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::summarise(x = median(umap1), y = median(umap2), .groups = "drop") |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster")
```

# Run Slingshot

```{r slingshot-run}
set.seed(42)
sling_obj <- slingshot::slingshot(
  data          = pca_emb,
  clusterLabels = clus,
  start.clus    = START_CLUSTER,
  end.clus      = END_CLUSTERS,
  dist.method   = "scaled.diag",
  extend        = "n",
  allow.breaks  = FALSE
)

lin_paths  <- slingshot::slingLineages(sling_obj)
n_lineages <- length(lin_paths)
cat("Lineages detected:", n_lineages, "\n")
for (i in seq_len(n_lineages))
  cat("  Lineage", i, ":", paste(lin_paths[[i]], collapse = " → "), "\n")
```

# MST on full UMAP

MST inferred by Slingshot overlaid on the full HSC UMAP (all cells as background).
Each panel highlights cells assigned to that lineage, coloured by pseudotime.

```{r mst-umap-setup}
g_mst <- slingshot::slingMST(sling_obj)

edges_umap <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_mst, what = "edges") |>
  dplyr::left_join(centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster") |>
    dplyr::rename(from = cluster, x_from = x, y_from = y), by = "from") |>
  dplyr::left_join(centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster") |>
    dplyr::rename(to   = cluster, x_to   = x, y_to   = y), by = "to")
```

```{r mst-umap-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Will be updated with per-lineage pseudotime after pseudotime-extract;
# here we show the MST + cluster labels on the full UMAP background.
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = umap_full,
             aes(umap1, umap2), colour = "grey88", size = 0.2, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = umap_df,
             aes(umap1, umap2, colour = cluster),
             size = 0.35, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = edges_umap,
               aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to),
               colour = "black", linewidth = 1.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
             aes(x, y), shape = 21, fill = "steelblue4", colour = "white",
             size = 5, stroke = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
    aes(x, y, label = cluster),
    size = 3, label.size = 0.2, fill = alpha("white", 0.8), max.overlaps = 30) +
  labs(title = "Slingshot MST on full HSC UMAP",
       x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Cluster") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.position = "right")
```

# Extract pseudotime

Pulled from `trajectory-slingshot.qmd`: `sling_cell_df()` returns raw + 0–100 scaled pseudotime
columns (`pseudotime_Lineage*`) plus within-lineage ranks and summary columns.

```{r sling-cell-df-fn}
sling_cell_df <- function(sling_ctr) {
  raw_pt <- slingshot::slingPseudotime(sling_ctr)

  pseudotime_df <- apply(raw_pt, 2, function(x) {
    x1 <- x[!is.na(x)]
    x[!is.na(x)] <- (x1 - min(x1)) / (max(x1) - min(x1)) * 100
    x
  }) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("pseudotime_", .)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      mean_pseudotime   = rowMeans(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pseudotime = apply(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_pseudotime    = apply(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), 1, max,    na.rm = TRUE),
      min_pseudotime    = apply(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), 1, min,    na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  order_df <- apply(raw_pt, 2, function(x) {
    x[!is.na(x)] <- rank(x[!is.na(x)])
    x
  }) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("order_", .)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(mean_order = rowMeans(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), na.rm = TRUE))

  dplyr::bind_cols(as.data.frame(raw_pt), pseudotime_df, order_df)
}
```

```{r pseudotime-extract}
sling_df             <- sling_cell_df(sling_obj)
sling_df$cluster     <- clus[rownames(sling_df)]
sling_df$condition   <- label_condition(mpn_processed_hsc$sample.name[rownames(sling_df)])
sling_df$sample.name <- mpn_processed_hsc$sample.name[rownames(sling_df)]

# Raw lineage cols (e.g. "Lineage1") — used for bin_expr_along_pseudotime
raw_lin_cols <- grep("^Lineage[0-9]", colnames(sling_df), value = TRUE)
# Scaled pseudotime cols (e.g. "pseudotime_Lineage1") — used for smooth expression
pt_lin_cols  <- grep("^pseudotime_Lineage", colnames(sling_df), value = TRUE)

cat("Raw lineage columns:", paste(raw_lin_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Cells per lineage (non-NA):\n")
for (lc in raw_lin_cols)
  cat(" ", lc, ":", sum(!is.na(sling_df[[lc]])), "\n")

# Identify 8→4 vs 6→4 lineages by which has more cluster-8 vs cluster-6 cells
cells_8 <- rownames(sling_df)[sling_df$cluster == "8"]
cells_6 <- rownames(sling_df)[sling_df$cluster == "6"]

lin_bias <- sapply(raw_lin_cols, function(lc) {
  sum(!is.na(sling_df[cells_8, lc])) - sum(!is.na(sling_df[cells_6, lc]))
})
names(lin_bias) <- raw_lin_cols

lin_8to4_raw <- raw_lin_cols[which.max(lin_bias)]   # raw col for bin_mats
lin_6to4_raw <- raw_lin_cols[which.min(lin_bias)]
lin_8to4_pt  <- paste0("pseudotime_", lin_8to4_raw) # scaled col for smooth
lin_6to4_pt  <- paste0("pseudotime_", lin_6to4_raw)

cat("\nLineage bias (n_c8 - n_c6):\n"); print(lin_bias)
cat("→ 8→4:", lin_8to4_raw, "| path:", paste(lin_paths[[lin_8to4_raw]], collapse=" → "), "\n")
cat("→ 6→4:", lin_6to4_raw, "| path:", paste(lin_paths[[lin_6to4_raw]], collapse=" → "), "\n")

# Reverse pseudotime: slingshot ran with start=4 so pt=0 at c4.
# After reversal: pt=0 at c6/c8 (progenitor) and pt=max at c4 (end).
for (lc in raw_lin_cols) {
  m <- max(sling_df[[lc]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sling_df[[lc]] <- ifelse(is.na(sling_df[[lc]]), NA_real_, m - sling_df[[lc]])
}
for (pt_col in pt_lin_cols) {
  sling_df[[pt_col]] <- ifelse(is.na(sling_df[[pt_col]]), NA_real_,
                               100 - sling_df[[pt_col]])
}
cat("Pseudotime reversed: 0 = progenitor (c6/c8), 100 = c4\n")
```

```{r lineage-umap, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
pt_umap_df <- umap_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sling_df |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
      dplyr::select(cell_id, dplyr::all_of(pt_lin_cols)),
    by = "cell_id"
  )

plots_lin <- lapply(seq_along(raw_lin_cols), function(i) {
  lc   <- pt_lin_cols[i]
  lnm  <- raw_lin_cols[i]
  traj_label <- if (lnm == lin_8to4_raw) "8→4" else "6→4"
  lin  <- rev(lin_paths[[lnm]])   # reverse path label to match reversed pseudotime
  ggplot(pt_umap_df |> dplyr::arrange(is.na(.data[[lc]]))) +
    geom_point(data = umap_full, aes(umap1, umap2),
               colour = "grey88", size = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(umap1, umap2), colour = "grey80", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(umap1, umap2, colour = .data[[lc]]),
               size = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_segment(data = edges_umap,
                 aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to),
                 colour = "black", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
               aes(x, y), shape = 21, fill = "steelblue4", colour = "white",
               size = 4, stroke = 0.7) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
      aes(x, y, label = cluster), size = 2.5, label.size = 0.2,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.8), max.overlaps = 30) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Pseudotime", na.value = NA) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title    = paste(lnm, "—", traj_label),
         subtitle = paste(lin, collapse = " → ")) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey40"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots_lin, ncol = 2) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Per-lineage pseudotime on full HSC UMAP (reversed: 0 = progenitor)",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
  )
```

# Binned expression heatmap

50 pseudotime bins, top `r N_TOP_GENES_HM` genes by bin variance.
Trajectory **6→4** displayed left-to-right; trajectory **8→4** displayed right-to-left (columns reversed).

```{r bin-compute}
bin_mats <- lapply(raw_lin_cols, function(lc) {
    cat("Binning", lc, "...\n")
    bin_expr_along_pseudotime(
      srt         = mpn_processed_hsc,
      sling_df    = sling_df,
      lineage_col = lc,
      n_bins      = N_BINS_HM,
      assay       = "SCT",
      layer       = "data",
      smooth      = TRUE,
      smooth_span = 0.3
    )
  }) %>%
  setNames(.,raw_lin_cols)

cat("Bin matrices:\n")
for (nm in names(bin_mats))
  cat(" ", nm, "—", nrow(bin_mats[[nm]]), "genes ×", ncol(bin_mats[[nm]]), "bins\n")
```

```{r bin-heatmap, fig.width=10}
#| fig.height: !expr min(22, ceiling(N_TOP_GENES_HM / 5))

# Reverse columns of 8→4 matrix for right-to-left display
bin_mats_8rev <- bin_mats
bin_mats_8rev[[lin_8to4_raw]] <- bin_mats_8rev[[lin_8to4_raw]][
  , ncol(bin_mats_8rev[[lin_8to4_raw]]):1, drop = FALSE
]

# Gene order anchored to 6→4 (left-to-right, reference); display 6→4 then 8→4
bin_mats_plot <- list(
  `6→4  [L→R]` = bin_mats_8rev[[lin_6to4_raw]],
  `8→4  [R→L]` = bin_mats_8rev[[lin_8to4_raw]]
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  plot_lineage_heatmap(
    bin_mats_plot,
    n_top          = N_TOP_GENES_HM,
    gene_order     = "peak",
    scale          = TRUE,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_names_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 6),
    row_names_side = "left"
  ),
  merge_legend    = TRUE,
  column_title    = paste("Top", N_TOP_GENES_HM, "variable genes — 50 bins, z-scored"),
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
)
```

# Top-3 gene expression by sample

Top 3 genes per trajectory selected by bin variance.
Lines coloured by `sample.name`, faceted by gene × trajectory.

```{r smooth-by-sample-fn}
# Pulled from trajectory-slingshot.qmd: get_smooth_expr_by_condition()
# lins should be pseudotime_Lineage* column names (or raw — sub() is a no-op on raw names)
get_smooth_expr_by_condition <- function(lins, lin_markers_lst, sling_df, srt,
                                         condition_col = "condition",
                                         n_bins = 50, loess_span = 0.75) {
  lin_markers_df <- tibble::enframe(lin_markers_lst,
                                    name  = "clust_marker",
                                    value = "gene_symbol") |>
    tidyr::unnest(cols = gene_symbol)

  traj_long_df <- sling_df[, c(lins, condition_col), drop = FALSE] |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(lins),
                        names_to  = "lins",
                        values_to = "pseudotime") |>
    dplyr::mutate(lins = sub("pseudotime_", "", lins)) |>
    dplyr::rename(condition = dplyr::all_of(condition_col)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pt_norm = (pseudotime - min(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                (max(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE) - min(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  sct_norm_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
  sct_norm_mat <- sct_norm_mat[
    intersect(lin_markers_df$gene_symbol, rownames(sct_norm_mat)), , drop = FALSE
  ]

  sct_long_df <- sct_norm_mat |>
    as.matrix() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene_symbol, names_to = "cell_id", values_to = "sct") |>
    dplyr::left_join(lin_markers_df, by = "gene_symbol")

  dplyr::full_join(traj_long_df, sct_long_df, by = "cell_id",
                   relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(pt_bin_id = cut(pt_norm, breaks = n_bins,
                                  labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins, gene_symbol, condition, pt_bin_id, clust_marker) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_sct = mean(sct, na.rm = TRUE),
                     pt_norm  = mean(pt_norm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins, gene_symbol, condition) |>
    dplyr::reframe({
      d      <- dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything())
      pt_seq <- seq(min(d$pt_norm), max(d$pt_norm), length.out = 100)
      fit    <- loess(mean_sct ~ pt_norm, data = d, span = loess_span, degree = 1)
      tibble::tibble(
        pseudotime_bin   = pt_seq,
        smooth_norm_expr = predict(fit, pt_seq),
        clust_marker     = dplyr::first(d$clust_marker)
      )
    }) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      clust_marker = factor(clust_marker, levels = names(lin_markers_lst)),
      lineage      = lins
    )
}
```

```{r top-genes-select}
top_8to4 <- names(sort(apply(bin_mats[[lin_8to4_raw]], 1, var, na.rm = TRUE),
                        decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(N_TOP_GENES_LINE)]
top_6to4 <- names(sort(apply(bin_mats[[lin_6to4_raw]], 1, var, na.rm = TRUE),
                        decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(N_TOP_GENES_LINE)]
cat("Top genes 8→4:", paste(top_8to4, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Top genes 6→4:", paste(top_6to4, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r smooth-compute}
smooth_8to4 <- get_smooth_expr_by_condition(
  lins            = lin_8to4_pt,
  lin_markers_lst = setNames(as.list(top_8to4), top_8to4),
  sling_df        = sling_df,
  srt             = mpn_processed_hsc,
  condition_col   = "sample.name",
  n_bins          = N_BINS_HM
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(trajectory = paste0(lin_8to4_raw, ": 8→4"))

smooth_6to4 <- get_smooth_expr_by_condition(
  lins            = lin_6to4_pt,
  lin_markers_lst = setNames(as.list(top_6to4), top_6to4),
  sling_df        = sling_df,
  srt             = mpn_processed_hsc,
  condition_col   = "sample.name",
  n_bins          = N_BINS_HM
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(trajectory = paste0(lin_6to4_raw, ": 6→4"))

smooth_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(smooth_8to4, smooth_6to4)
```

```{r line-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
sample_pal <- setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(smooth_combined$condition))),
  sort(unique(smooth_combined$condition))
)

ggplot(smooth_combined,
       aes(pseudotime_bin, smooth_norm_expr,
           colour = condition,
           group  = condition)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sample_pal, name = "Sample") +
  facet_grid(clust_marker ~ trajectory, scales = "free") +
  labs(x     = "Pseudotime (0–100)",
       y     = "Smoothed SCT expression",
       title = paste("Top", N_TOP_GENES_LINE, "genes per trajectory — by sample")) +
  theme(strip.text.x    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        strip.text.y    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, angle = 0),
        panel.spacing   = unit(0.6, "lines"),
        legend.position = "right")
```
